outcome: breastfeeding initiation (exclusive, any, or formula feeding) at hospital discharge
cohort: The study included 674 primiparous women with Class 3 obesity who delivered live singletons without major malformations at >= 34 weeks gestation in the study institution between 2013 and 2021.
finding: Among primiparous women with Class 3 obesity who intended to exclusively breastfeed, public healthcare assistance, African American race, preeclampsia, cesarean delivery, neonatal hypoglycemia, prematurity, and NICU admission were strong predictors of failure to initiate breastfeeding.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was identified as a strong predictor of failure to initiate breastfeeding among primiparous women with Class 3 obesity who intended to breastfeed.
